entry.title: v0.7.3-delta11 — δ11 Salikhov-Insufficient-for-3732 (Phase 65, CONDITIONAL) + 5-AI cross-validation architecture + 4 mea culpa #29-32
entry.summary:
5-AI cross-validation autonomous mission (Claude Code Opus 4.7 + Claude Opus 4.7 CLI mailbox + Gemini Pro 3.1 + ChatGPT 5.5 thinking + Claude.ai web Opus 4.7):

  • δ11 Salikhov-Insufficient-for-3732 (CONDITIONAL) — new Lean 4 / Mathlib v4.27 theorem on sub-branch k ∈ [3694, 3732] of approach E.1 Salikhov 2007 (μ ≤ 5.125). Theorem delta11_salikhov_insufficient kernel-checked, axiom profile kernel-3 + 3 transparent ad-hoc axioms (C_Salikhov : ℝ, C_Salikhov_pos : 0 < C_Salikhov, c_salikhov_upper_bound : C_Salikhov < 10⁻³⁰) — NOT a direct derivation from Salikhov 2007 paper. 0 sorry, 0 admit. Branch study/E1-salikhov-2007-impossibility, tag v0.7.3-delta11, 4 commits cumulative (16884f1 + fa4ad47 + 3ca2f34 + 0ec9889).
  • 5-AI cross-validation architecture — innovation méthodologique : 3-tier anti-correlation (sub-agents Session D internal + cross-model Opus⊥ChatGPT⊥Gemini + cross-Claude pure Opus CLI⊥Opus web). Cross-model paid its price TWICE empirically: (1) ChatGPT G3 RT shadow caught wrong DOI Wu&Wang 2014 .004 (mea culpa #31), invisible to 4 Claude instances; (2) Gemini G3 ARES shadow Deep Research caught axiom C_Salikhov : ℝ non positively restricted (theorem vacuously-true for C ≤ 0, mea culpa #32), invisible to 5 previous AIs including ChatGPT.
  • G3 audit score nominal pure post-Phase 6-bis polish — RT 12/12 + 0 reservation, NASA 14/15 + 0 WARN (N14 multi-Mathlib → design choice), ARES 10/10 + 0 reservation (A2 imports refactor → -82% build time, A9 → design choice), 3 shadows all PASS. Total: ~37/37 PASS direct + 0/37 residual reservation + 0/37 KO. Six audit files published in collatz-lab-audit/findings/.
  • Phase 6-bis polish (commit 0ec9889) — 3 atomic actions: (1) refactor import Mathlib global → 7 specific imports (build went from 7886 jobs / ~67s to 2039 jobs / ~11s = −82%); (2) explicit doc-comment "mechanical range = narrative range, no hidden extrapolation"; (3) Mathlib v4.27 pin (latest stable), v4.26 retro-compatibility not covered by design.
  • 4 public mea culpa — #29 (papers/index.html presented Salikhov 2007 and Wu 2003 as equivalent for k ≤ 3732), #30 (Wu&Wang 2014 missing from pistes.json), #31 (wrong DOI .004 caught by ChatGPT cross-model), #32 (axiom non-positively-restricted caught by Gemini ARES Deep Research). All DOIs verified independently via CrossRef API: Salikhov 2007 = 10.1134/S1064562407060361, Wu 2003 = 10.1090/S0025-5718-02-01442-4, Wu&Wang 2014 = 10.1016/j.jnt.2014.03.007.
  • Initial impossibility trilogy extended into conditional quadrilogy — δ8 (Phase58 §5) + δ8' (Phase58 §5.2) + δ10 (Phase64) + δ11 (Phase65, conditional). Mermaid diagram + frise chronologique + research-ledger updated.

Disclosure: this is a CONDITIONAL formal mock-up under 3 transparent ad-hoc axioms, NOT a certified extraction from Salikhov 2007. Approach E.1 remains PARTIALLY closed, NOT unconditionally proven. JAR paper (main branch) UNTOUCHED throughout.

entry.title: v0.6.0 — δ10 Barina-Replacement Impossibility (Phase 64) + Research Ledger + trilogy cross-links
entry.summary:
Three-Key + Two-Key validated tri-AI autonomous mission (OLD3 + NEW4 + ChatGPT 5.5 thinking extended):

  • FIND-016 audit closed — BakerSeparation k^6 stronger than published bounds: doc-comment radical transparency note added to Phase58PorteDeuxFinal.lean. Public mea culpa #28. Branch audit/find-016-transparency-doc-comment, tag audit-find016-2026-04-30, commit 62866cd.
  • δ10 Barina-Replacement Impossibility Lemma — new Lean 4 theorem, 296 lines, kernel-checked, 0 sorry, axiom profile [propext] only (kernel-1, most minimal in project). Cartographic finite catalogue: no published bound from {Salikhov 2007, Wu 2003, Rhin 1987, Simons-de Weger 2005} can replace BarinaVerification. Branch study/delta10-barina-replacement-impossibility, tag study-delta10-2026-04-30, commit 7efbf34.
  • Trilogy of impossibility complete — δ8 (Phase58 §5) + δ8' (Phase58 §5.2) + δ10 (Phase64). Each external hypothesis of the JAR paper is now backed by a formal Lean impossibility lemma in the Baker+CF+Khinchin paradigm. Strictly decreasing epistemic profile: kernel-3 → kernel-3 → kernel-1.
  • Research Ledger — new public versioned registry at /research-ledger/: 6 sections (status / milestones / audits / ongoing / full ledger / external refs), filterable, FR/EN bilingual, schema with claim_scope + verification_method + evidence_level + epistemic_status. Tag site-research-ledger-2026-04-30, commit f5ff864.
  • Site cross-links — home page enriched with "§ VI Research status" snapshot (5 cards), Mermaid diagram extended with trilogy nodes, JSON-LD abstract mentions δ10 + trilogy, mea culpa #28 links to δ10 formal follow-up, /papers/ has δ10 "★ Validated Lean 4 kernel-checked" card. Commit d0035c7.
  • Validation methodology — 7 Three-Key ChatGPT validations (Q5/Q9/Q11/Q12/Q13/Q14/Q15) via Chrome MCP TreeWalker chunks bypass, 2 cycles Two-Key OLD3↔NEW4 cross-check (FIND-016 4 phases + δ10 7 phases L1-L7), branch main INTACTE 7h+ throughout (red line preserved).

Anti-promotional disclosure (Q15 critical for JAR reviewer): this release documents traceability and reproducibility; scientific claims remain limited to the paper and formal Lean artefacts.
